exec: A maintenance-related disruption to a top-secret government network; critical communications reportedly stayed available.
impact: The agency staggered staff arrivals while it assessed the scope.
plain: The classified internal network used by US National Security Agency staff went down or ran intermittently on November 17. The agency says routine scheduled maintenance caused it; there is no evidence of a cyberattack.
summary: CNN reported, citing six people, that NSA Net went down on November 17; other sources say it was intermittent. The NSA cites degradation during scheduled routine maintenance and says mission-critical capabilities remain fully operational. DNI Jay Clayton blamed a patch for PHP vulnerabilities that stopped some systems restarting and said there is no evidence of a cyberattack. Restoration is not confirmed. Cyber cause: not indicated.
title: NSA's classified internal network NSA Net goes down

validation.note: Agency statement plus several outlets; extent of the outage is described differently by different sources.

review.note: Added DNI stated cause (PHP patch) and intermittent description; no evidence of cyberattack wording per The Record and WRAL
